summary: ABVC BioPharma filed an 8-K announcing postponement of its previously scheduled spin-off distribution of BioKey (Cayman) ordinary shares, originally set for August 3, 2026. The record date and distribution ratio of 0.169464 BioKey shares per ABVC common share remain unchanged, but the ex-dividend date is revised. The delay is to complete administrative, regulatory, and tax matters. ABVC is coordinating with Nasdaq, DTC, and its transfer agent. Watch for the revised distribution and ex-dividend dates, and the risk-arb angle centers on timing uncertainty and completion of the spin-off.
